system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 47. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (21 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (desperate, weeping): "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
[b01] CATHERINE (sobbing, pleading): "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
[b02] LADY ASHBOURNE (cold, unforgiving): "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
[b03] VAUGHN (gruff, ready): "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
[b04] ALEXANDER (furious, decisive): "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
[b05] CATHERINE (hysterical, screaming): "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"

--- WINDOW 1 (30 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (hysterical, screaming): "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
[b01] JULIANA (clear, authoritative): "Stop."
[b02] ALEXANDER (indignant, protective): "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
[b03] JULIANA (calm, composed): "She did."
[b04] JULIANA (dignified, principled): "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
[b05] ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
[b06] JULIANA (steely, direct): "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
[b07] CATHERINE (incredulous, stunned): "You want me? As a guest?"
[b08] JULIANA (unflinching, firm): "As a scullery maid."
[b09] CATHERINE (outraged, venomous): "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[b10] JULIANA (measured, commanding): "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."

--- WINDOW 2 (36 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.
[b01] JULIANA (despairing): "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
[b02] ALEXANDER (gentle, resolute): "Look at me, Juliana."
[b03] ALEXANDER (fierce, loving): "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
[b04] ALEXANDER (deep, unwavering): "You are my wife."
[b05] ACTION: Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.
[b06] ALEXANDER (authoritative, steadfast): "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
[b07] LADY ASHBOURNE (sharp, contemptuous): "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
[b08] CATHERINE (desperate, weeping): "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
[b09] CATHERINE (sobbing, pleading): "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"

--- WINDOW 3 (30 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (outraged, venomous): "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[b01] JULIANA (measured, commanding): "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
[b02] JULIANA (stern, demanding): "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
[b03] JULIANA (unforgiving): "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
[b04] JULIANA (stern, final): "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
[b05] CATHERINE (choked, humiliated): "You humiliate me."
[b06] JULIANA (calm, sovereign): "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
[b07] CATHERINE (broken, defeated): "I accept, Your Grace."

Pick the single best promo.
